Name: Joshua, Son of Jehozadak
Summary: Joshua, son of Jehozadak, was the high priest of the returned exiles, working alongside Zerubbabel the governor and the prophets Haggai and Zechariah. Zechariah's visions show him standing before the LORD in filthy garments, cleansed and clothed anew — a picture of Israel's own restoration. He is a different man from Joshua son of Nun.
KeyStory: Joshua the high priest stood before the LORD in filthy garments, was cleansed and given a clean turban, and crowned with the hopes of the returning nation.
RelatedPeople: Haggai; Zechariah the Prophet; Zerubbabel; Jehozadak
LifeLesson: Joshua's filthy garments became clean ones — not by his scrubbing, but by God's word. Restoration is a gift, not an achievement.
